name: fixbridge
description: Verified hyperlocal skilled-services marketplace — modular monolith (internal codename: fixbridge; brand name not decided, see APP_NAME).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/shared && npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/api && npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/web
scripts.start:dev: npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/shared && npm run start:dev --workspace @fixbridge/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/shared && npm run test --workspace @fixbridge/api && npm run test --workspace @fixbridge/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/shared && npm run test:unit --workspace @fixbridge/api && npm run test --workspace @fixbridge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @fixbridge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fixbridge/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @fixbridge/web
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
